name: bluebite-mern-app
description: Zomato-inspired Food Discovery Application with MERN Stack

scripts.dev: node -e "const { spawn } = require('child_process'); spawn('npm', ['--prefix', 'server', 'run', 'dev'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); spawn('npm', ['--prefix', 'client', 'run', 'dev'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true });"
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.build: npm --prefix client install --include=dev && npm --prefix client run build && npm --prefix server install
